findings.title: Removed public `findMany` method breaks existing callers
findings.body: The diff deletes `InsightsBookingService.findMany` and replaces it with `getBaseConditions`. `findMany` was the method that executed the Prisma query on `bookingTimeStatusDenormalized`, allowing callers to pass `select`, additional `where` clauses, etc. Any code importing this exported service and calling `service.findMany(...)` will fail to compile after this PR. If this change is intentional, callers need to be migrated in the same PR; otherwise keep `findMany` implemented in terms of the new raw conditions or provide a compatibility adapter.

findings.title: `teamId` is optional in public options even when scope is `team`
findings.body: `InsightsBookingServicePublicOptions` types `teamId` as `number | undefined` for all scopes, but `insightsBookingServiceOptionsSchema` requires `teamId` for `scope: 'team'`. As a result, callers can write `{ scope: 'team', userId, orgId }` without a TypeScript error; the constructor then fails validation, sets `this.options` to `null`, and `getAuthorizationConditions()` returns `NOTHING_CONDITION`. This silently returns no data rather than surfacing the missing required option. Use a discriminated public type or throw a clear validation error.

findings.title: Caching tests removed without replacement
findings.body: The previous `Caching` describe block tested that `getAuthorizationConditions()` and `getFilterConditions()` return the same cached result on repeated calls. Those tests were deleted in this PR, but the caching fields and `=== undefined` checks remain in the service. Caching can now regress unnoticed. Replace these tests with updated raw-SQL assertions rather than deleting them.
